summary: Recorded the measured interpretation of the four-case experiment (CheckRun 62f089bd843641099558ff8d8831ab29, exit 0, tests_passed), which confirms by retained execution that the compaction condition is necessary but not sufficient. Parsed indices: 35 (backlog case, TrailingLogs=2) successor_snapshot with snapshot_index 4, successor_applied_index 60, successor_last_index 63 and successor_store_first/last 5..63, so the leader's retained log began above its own snapshot index; 43 rejoin_observe with restores_before/early/late all 0, partner_applied_index 64 equal to successor_applied_index 64, partner_store 61..62 against successor_store 63..64. In the same receipt the TrailingLogs=0 case loops (partner applied index 4, last index 7, thousands of installs) while the (10,20) and (25,20) cases converge with restores 0 and indexes 24. Conclusion violated / defect_claim refuted for that prediction: a leader with non-zero TrailingLogs that snapshots under a real backlog, with its snapshot boundary compacted away, still left the peer repairable with no InstallSnapshot at all. The unexplained element — the peer's store (61..62) differing from the leader's (63..64) at the same applied index while the peer applied 61 commands, consistent with the peer snapshotting on its own under the shared small SnapshotThreshold — is recorded as the next discriminator rather than assumed. The scope of the finding is therefore fixed and must be presented strictly as: with TrailingLogs=0 and a snapshot taken at the log end, evidenced by the single-peer witness CheckRun 7772ad1b5b154d498a27a79806bb0ea7, the sealed-partition witness CheckRun f66fa4e4e0514f7e95b7788032144a30, and the cause-isolating control CheckRun beca431464bf44ab9c3354145c21899f; no claim is made that a non-zero trailing configuration reproduces the loop. A Fact knowledge entry records the retained operands with the frozen-snapshot conditions, counterevidence and limitations (peer snapshotting confound, unidentified repair mechanism, in-process setup). Structural validation returned valid=true.
